Vanessa / team — I reviewed the request. Security position: we can approve a maximum 48-hour retention snapshot for debugging with the following conditions:

- Scope: single time window as requested; no additional windows without a new request.
- Access: access only via secure SFTP link with mTLS and IP restriction (BrightRetail SRE IPs only).
- Data minimization: redact PII fields and exclude any persistent customer identifiers; provide tokenized request/response and KV-cache index rather than raw payloads where feasible.
- Auditability: every access attempt logged and stored per standard audit retention.
- Approval: Legal must sign an exception acknowledgement; Support must include a runbook for snapshot creation and destruction.

Priyom — can your ops team produce the snapshot and the one-time access link? If yes, we'll coordinate Legal for the acknowledgement doc.

—Marcus
